summary: Full E2E test (backend + frontend) of Telluric Gaia Apparel Lab. 20/20 pytest backend tests passed. All 11 features in review request verified via Playwright: home, catalog filters (hemp->3), product detail (gallery/size/tabs), add-to-cart + slide-out drawer, 3-step simulated checkout producing TG- tracking hash, email/password auth, admin login + admin link visibility, admin CRUD (add->edit->delete) on products, non-admin blocked from /admin (redirect) and from POST /api/products (403), Eco Review page, Account page with order history, Thermochromic slider mutating --thermo CSS var from cyan rgb(0,242,254) to amber rgb(242,101,64).

issues: Radix DialogContent emits console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` (accessibility, non-blocking)

action_items: Minor spec mismatch (not a bug, flag for E1): review_request lists shipping testid as `ship-full-name`, but implementation uses `ship-name`. Either update spec or add alias. All tests used the actual implemented testid.

Review_request also listed filter testids as `filter-material-Hemp Canvas`; actual implementation slugs to `filter-material-hemp-canvas` (lowercase, hyphenated). Document correct convention for next agent.
(Optional) Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to CartDrawer and other Radix dialogs to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~570 lines): well structured but mixes auth/products/orders in a single module. Consider splitting into routers once it exceeds 700 lines.
google-session endpoint stores plain data.email/name without validating payload shape; if Emergent returns unexpected shape it will KeyError and surface 500. Wrap in try/except with 401.
orders POST endpoint accepts arbitrary subtotal/total from client (not recomputed server-side). Low-risk since checkout is simulated, but for a real store this is tamper-prone.
CORS allow_origins falls back to http://localhost:3000 when FRONTEND_URL is missing; verify FRONTEND_URL env is set in prod to match REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL origin for cookie withCredentials to work.
Admin password compare on seed uses verify_password on possibly-null hash via short-circuit (OK), but seed does not update the name/role fields other than password/role. Acceptable.
Frontend: filter chip testid slug relies on toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g,'-') which is case-insensitive—OK, but documenting the final data-testid in review_request would prevent agent drift.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@telluricgaia.com / TelluricAdmin#2026. Customer: auto-registered TEST_* and timestamp-based emails during tests.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 8 products and admin user on startup. Tests created transient TEST_* users and one QA_Test_Product (deleted at end). Several test orders remain in DB from checkout runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend_test.py uses pytest with session-scoped admin/customer fixtures and requests.Session cookies. Frontend uses httpOnly cookies with SameSite=None/Secure (works over https preview URL). Correct filter testid slugs are kebab-case lowercase (e.g. filter-material-hemp-canvas). Shipping form field testid is ship-name (not ship-full-name). CartDrawer opens automatically on add-to-cart (don't click nav-cart-button right after ATC — overlay will block it). page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle') occasionally times out due to analytics/pings; prefer 'domcontentloaded' + short sleep.
rca of the issue: No functional defects found. Only spec-vs-implementation testid naming mismatches, which were trivially worked around.
